quote_zh: [0016] In process variant A), it is appropriate to initially charge a compound of the formula I with N-bromosuccinimide (NBS) and radical initiator in solvent, and then to heat gradually. The reaction may optionally be accelerated by adding a little bromine. Preference is given to using NBS in excess.

They are on the record as named substances with an empty quantity, which is what the section supports.
